in_hebrew.name: Erland
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Famous spear ruler
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Erland הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old Norse words er meaning 'ruler, earl' and land meaning 'territory'. This name was likely given to someone who ruled over a large territory or who wielded great power.

in_greek.name: Erland

in_greek.long_meaning: Erland είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from Old Norse words er meaning 'ruler, earl' and land meaning 'territory'. This name was likely given to someone who ruled over a large territory or who wielded great power.

in_latin.name: Erland
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Famous spear ruler
in_latin.long_meaning: Erland est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from Old Norse words er meaning 'ruler, earl' and land meaning 'territory'. This name was likely given to someone who ruled over a large territory or who wielded great power.
